The '''Wookiee land wars''' was a conflict that occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ska Gora]] sometime between [[25,797 BBY]] and [[25,793 BBY]].<ref name="Into the Void" /> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Gharcanna]] led many of his [[Species/Legends|species]] to settle in the forests on the surface of Ska Gora, ignoring the fact that doing so was illegal,<ref name="DOTJ 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> and the [[Je'daii Council]] dispatched [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] to Ska Gora to settle the matter. Brock tried diplomatic methods to convince Gharcanna to leave, but when they failed, the Ranger was forced to turn her [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on the Wookiees in order to prevent civil war breaking out between the Wookiees and those who lived on the floating [[City/Legends|city]]-ships above Ska Gora's surface. In her [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|''Peacemaker''-class cruiser]], she bombarded the surface where the Wookiees lived, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all of the illegal settlers. Brock was haunted by her actions on Ska Gora, and regretted how Gharcanna had refused to back down and forced her hand.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wookiee land wars were first mentioned in the short story ''[[The Adventures of Lanoree Brock, Je'daii Ranger]]'', and it was expanded upon in the short story ''[[Eruption]]'' and the novel ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''.
